name: App Update

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-app:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Show repo info
        run: |
          git status
          ls -la
          find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -n 50

      - name: Commit pending changes if any
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Automated app update"
          git push
